description: Controlled authored scientific passage fixture; not a benchmark on a user library or full papers. Each query has one preregistered relevant passage.

passages.text: Randomization distributes measured and unmeasured confounders between treatment arms in expectation. Allocation concealment prevents investigators from predicting assignment.
Blinding prevents participants and outcome assessors from knowing the assigned treatment. It reduces performance and detection biases after allocation.
A confidence interval quantifies uncertainty around an estimated population effect. A 95% confidence procedure covers the true parameter in 95% of repeated samples.
A prediction interval describes where a future individual observation may lie. It includes both uncertainty in the estimated mean and individual variation.
Multiple imputation replaces each missing value with several plausible draws and pools estimates across completed datasets. It propagates uncertainty about missing data.
Complete-case analysis excludes observations with any missing required variables. It may lose statistical power and introduce bias when missingness depends on outcomes.
La sensibilidad diagnóstica es la proporción de personas enfermas que reciben un resultado positivo. Una sensibilidad alta reduce los falsos negativos.
La especificidad diagnóstica es la proporción de personas sanas que reciben un resultado negativo. Una especificidad alta reduce los falsos positivos.
In RNA sequencing, differential expression analysis identifies genes whose transcript abundance changes between experimental conditions, after accounting for library size.
Single-cell RNA sequencing measures transcript abundance in individual cells, enabling identification of heterogeneous cell populations hidden by bulk measurements.
Los modelos de efectos aleatorios de un metaanálisis permiten que el efecto verdadero varíe entre estudios e incorporan la heterogeneidad entre ellos.
El sesgo de publicación aparece cuando la probabilidad de publicar un estudio depende de sus resultados. Los estudios con resultados nulos pueden quedar infrarrepresentados.
Contrastive learning trains representations by bringing positive pairs closer and separating negative pairs in an embedding space. It is commonly used for semantic retrieval.
A cross-encoder reranker jointly reads a query and a candidate passage to estimate relevance. Unlike independent embeddings it must process each query-passage pair.
La conductividad térmica mide la facilidad con la que un material transmite calor bajo un gradiente de temperatura. No equivale a la energía necesaria para calentarlo.
La capacidad calorífica específica es la energía necesaria para elevar en un grado la temperatura de una unidad de masa. Describe almacenamiento de energía térmica.
Longitudinal cohort studies repeatedly observe the same participants over time. They can establish temporal ordering between an exposure and a subsequent outcome.
Cross-sectional studies measure exposure and outcome at one time point. They estimate prevalence but generally cannot establish which came first.
